definition: In this historical psychology usage, disaggregation means a more severe form of pathological dissociation in which the usual unity of conscious thought breaks apart. Part of mental life becomes separated from the rest, so the person in a normal state may not know what occurred in the abnormal state and may have only dim awareness while in it.
